0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons (2-0, first in the Central and first in the East) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (3-0, first in the Atlantic and second in the East), who are riding a three-game winning streak. Detroit has not played a regular-season game against Philadelphia yet this season, but it won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026. For the Pistons, Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. For the 76ers, Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain) are out, while Jabari Walker (knee), Joel Embiid (rest), and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
